definition: The lowest low of the current session so far. Each bar carries its close time in nanoseconds UTC as time; a session opens at session_start seconds into its clock's day and lasts until the next one opens.
boundaries: One session per local day of its clock; bars without a time are missing. session_start is a second of clock's day: clock 0 is UTC, 1 is London and 2 is New York, so a session opens at the market's own time on both sides of a clock change.
recognition: A break of the session's high or low is a common breakout level.

sources.quote: The lowest price traded within a defined trading session up to the current moment.

tests: on clock 0 its values equal version 1's over its golden bars, in qml/tests/test_session_clock.py
